visual_action: A slideshow of still, unflattering photographs of Donald Trump. The images include a side view showing thinning hair, a close-up of his face with an orange tint and eyes closed, him playing golf, and him wearing a red "MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN" hat. The slideshow loops through some of the images.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The entire video is a montage of still photographs of Donald Trump.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue, only music with wordless vocals.
audio_music: The video features a soft, melodic pop track with wordless male vocals throughout. The music has a somewhat melancholic or gentle tone which creates an ironic contrast with the unflattering images on screen.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple, slow-paced slideshow of still images.
central_claim: Donald Trump is being presented in an unflattering light through a montage of poorly-timed or composed photographs.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump's appearance and diminish his public image.
